title: Exposing Bias in Online Communities through Large-Scale Language Models
findings: As an overall trend, average sentiment was highest for Christians and lowest for Muslims across the models. The ChristianChat model had the highest sentiment for Christians and significantly lower sentiment for Muslims. The Ummah model was more balanced regarding sentiment towards all three religions. The WallStreetBets model was found to be anti-Christian and anti-Muslim, but pro-Judaism. The NoNewNormal model exhibited more anti-Jewish bias than other models. Most models tested, including the base model, showed negative bias towards Muslims.
